tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header band, result list, details panel.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Idle pills, selected result row, close buttons.

tokens.name: quote-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a checked guide quote only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy, card summaries, the model's explanation.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: source, dates, counts, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and panel outlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: inputs, selects, ghost buttons, chips, toggles. At least 3:1 on bg (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Rules between result rows and table rows.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Primary button fill (one per area), eyebrow labels, the logo tile. A fill, never small text on paper; pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Ink on a saffron fill: primary button text, the logo's radar strokes.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text links and text buttons (Details →, Ask guide about this).

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Text on surface-tint pills and paper tags.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px focus outline. On terminals it is term-text.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the active pill or filter; text on it uses on-selected.

tokens.name: on-selected
tokens.usage: Text on a selected fill.

tokens.name: checked-bg
tokens.usage: 'Quote checked' badge and completed progress steps.

tokens.name: checked-ink
tokens.usage: Text on checked-bg.

tokens.name: not-stated
tokens.usage: 'Unknown' values, 'First seen' dates and cautions (cache, rate-limited, stale): facts no source gave or results to treat with care.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only: failed sources, failed requests, rejected claims, form errors. Always with words and an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: tag-model-bg
tokens.usage: Model tag fill.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Source answered. Only on console.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Source served from cache or rate-limited. Only on console.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Radar rings and decorative lines. Never a control border.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Behind the checked sentence in the source text.

tokens.name: proof-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the proof quote in the result preview and the guide pick. Same value as quote-bg.

tokens.name: proof-mark
tokens.usage: Highlight on the one sentence the guide checked, inside the proof quote.

tokens.name: pill-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill: Updated, Published, Quote checked.

tokens.name: pill-ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the ok status pill.

tokens.name: pill-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill: First seen (the source gave no date).

tokens.name: pill-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the warn status pill.

tokens.name: pill-next-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill of the next event. Has a 1px pill-next-line outline.

tokens.name: pill-next-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the next-event pill.

tokens.name: pill-next-line
tokens.usage: 1px inset outline of the next-event pill.

tokens.name: pill-later-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill of later events.

tokens.name: pill-later-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the later-event pill.

tokens.name: pill-later-line
tokens.usage: 1px inset outline of the later-event pill.

tokens.name: source-tile-bg
tokens.usage: One tile in the sources grid under the results.

tokens.name: source-tile-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a source tile.

tokens.name: status-ok-ink
tokens.usage: Status words and icons: answered, checked, succeeded.

tokens.name: status-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Status words and icons: slow, rate limited, timed out, sources disagree, not stated.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal windows: New this week, Coming up.

tokens.name: term-bar
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar.

tokens.name: term-text
tokens.usage: Terminal text, the cursor, the third window dot.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Terminal dates, sources, places. 8:1 on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-tag
tokens.usage: News type tags in a terminal: [model], [library].

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Terminal outline and the lines between its rows. About 2:1 on term-bg: a line, not a control.

tokens.name: term-control
tokens.usage: Border of buttons inside a terminal (btn-on-term). 4.8:1 on term-bg.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: The sticky header band: bg at 94%, so the page shows faintly under it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a dialog: the filters drawer. It dims the page so the dialog reads as the only thing to use.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Feed card titles and the guide's echoed question.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: An exact sentence from the source.

styles.name: input
styles.sample: Search or ask anything about AI

styles.name: mono-m
styles.usage: Resource names in results and details.

scale.rule: Every font size in the public CSS is one of these steps, in rem so it follows the font size the user set in the browser (WCAG 1.4.4). A step is named by its size in px at the default 16px. No text is under text-12. The steps are the sizes the screens used when the scale was written; a new size needs a new step here first.

tokens.name: text-12
tokens.usage: The floor. Eyebrow labels, AI labels, column heads, key hints, counts in chips, the tagline, status pills.

tokens.name: text-13
tokens.usage: Meta lines, the home and list tables, command lines, chips with a mouse.

tokens.name: text-14
tokens.usage: Small running text, buttons with a mouse, filter rows, notes, legacy tables.

tokens.name: text-15
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, facts, footer links, row descriptions.

tokens.name: text-16
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: text-17
tokens.usage: Reading text on text pages, quotes, result titles, the search field.

tokens.name: text-18
tokens.usage: Ledes of the standalone pages, the phone menu links, the small wordmark.

tokens.name: text-19
tokens.usage: The lede of a text page, saved and timeline titles.

tokens.name: text-20
tokens.usage: The wordmark, list headings, second stories.

tokens.name: text-22
tokens.usage: Card headings (sign in, account, dialog).

tokens.name: text-24
tokens.usage: Section headings (h2).

tokens.name: text-28
tokens.usage: The results heading.

tokens.name: text-hero
tokens.usage: The home title: 30px to 52px.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: The h1 of a text page or a list page: 28px to 44px.

tokens.name: text-title-lg
tokens.usage: The h1 of Sign in, Not found and the error page: 28px to 48px.

tokens.name: text-title-plain
tokens.usage: An h1 no page style sets (Support): 32px to 48px.

tokens.name: text-title-resource
tokens.usage: The resource title: 28.8px to 41.6px.

tokens.name: text-title-state
tokens.usage: A StatePanel that is the h1 of its page: 30.4px to 41.6px.

tokens.name: text-title-story
tokens.usage: The lead story on News: 28px to 40px.

styles.rule: Text styles that repeat. Each is one font shorthand in tokens.css and one class in styles/app.css.

tokens.name: type-eyebrow
tokens.usage: The small uppercase label above a group: Geist Mono 600, 12px, 0.08em letter spacing, uppercase.

tokens.name: type-meta
tokens.usage: A meta line: source, date, type, count. Geist Mono 400, 13px, in muted.

type.note: Geist Mono for the logo, headings, controls, labels, meta lines and the two home lists. Geist for running text: paragraphs, list items, quotes, descriptions. Both self-hosted (SIL Open Font License). These are the fonts of every page (ADR 0040). Code and key hints use the system monospace (code), nothing to download. In tokens.css: --font-mono, --font-body, --font-code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and inside card headers.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked card parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (vertical), gaps in grids.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Home hero padding, space below the main column.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small marks inside text or a control: key hints, the highlight in a quote, loading lines, the focus shape of a title link or a radar dot, the scrollbar of the search field.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Close buttons, small text buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, quotes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The search box, result list, guide picks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, guide picks and the guide answer panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, badges.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The logo tile only: the corners of the mark (assets/Logos/radar-mark.svg). Not for interface parts.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any control on a touch screen (pointer coarse or no hover).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, the view switch and the sort with a mouse and keyboard (pointer fine), on every page. Still above the 24px of WCAG 2.2 (2.5.8).

tokens.name: chip-sm
tokens.usage: Chips with a mouse and keyboard (pointer fine), on every page.

tokens.name: box-height
tokens.usage: The home search box and its button. 50px on phones, 46px in the header.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The sticky header. 65px on phones. The pinned search box sits right under it.

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column (header, home, lists).

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of one-column pages: Results, Resource, Saved, Account.

tokens.name: motion
tokens.usage: Hover and state changes. 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: fold
tokens.usage: The phone hero folding away, the pinned box getting compact.

tokens.name: radar-beam
tokens.usage: The home radar beam turns once every 5 s on one JavaScript clock with the dots; it stops while the mouse is over the radar or the focus is on a dot. Still under prefers-reduced-motion and with the account setting off.

tokens.name: radar-step
tokens.usage: The first 5 radar sources come 0.6 s apart; then one comes or goes every 1.6 s, 5 to 10 at a time, every source in turn.

tokens.name: radar-contact
tokens.usage: A radar dot when the beam passes it: full opacity, scale 1.35 back to 1, a glow in its colour, then it fades to 0.22. A source that leaves fades to 0 within 3 s.

tokens.name: shadow-pinned
tokens.usage: The search box once it is pinned while scrolling.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the filters drawer, the account panel, the phone menu, the More types list.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: A bar fixed to the bottom edge, with the shadow going up: the consent bar.

elevation.rule: A shadow is drawn in ink on paper and in black on the dark theme: ink is lighter than the dark page, so an ink shadow cannot be seen there.

layers.rule: Every z-index in the public CSS is one of these, named by what it is. The list is in order, the lowest first: a later layer covers an earlier one. A dialog (the filters drawer, Delete account) is a <dialog> in the top layer of the browser and needs no z-index.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: A link or a button inside a row whose title link covers the whole row: the host and Save in a result row.

tokens.name: z-list-columns
tokens.usage: The column names of a home list while the list scrolls under them.

tokens.name: z-list-head
tokens.usage: The head of a home list, and the two tabs on a phone, above the column names.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: A small list that opens under its button in the page: More types on the results page.

tokens.name: z-pinned
tokens.usage: The pinned home search box, above the lists.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header, above the pinned box.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: A menu that opens over the page, above the header.

tokens.name: z-consent
tokens.usage: The consent bar, fixed to the bottom, above everything in the page.

tokens.name: z-skip-link
tokens.usage: Skip to main content, above everything when it has the focus.

breakpoints.rule: A media query uses one of these widths: (max-width: W) up to it, (min-width: W + 1px) above it, or (min-width: W) from it. One height, in heights: (max-height: H) up to it. lib/breakpoints.ts has the same widths and height for the JavaScript queries; a test keeps the two and the CSS in step.

tokens.name: bp-narrow
tokens.usage: The search box puts Search and Ask the guide under the field; the results sort takes its own row.

tokens.name: bp-tiny
tokens.usage: The tagline hides; the wordmark is 20px; the account button shows only its avatar.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Steps and tables become cards; the saved rows and the timeline stack.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: Phone header: gutter 16px, News and Events in the menu, the header search on its own row; the home title folds; the results filters open as a drawer; one-column facts.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: The two home tables become one panel with two tabs and log rows; the proof strip takes two columns.

tokens.name: bp-split
tokens.usage: From the next pixel up, text pages show their contents beside the text.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: The two home tables stack; the radar shows only its rings and beam; the News front page and the Sources steps take fewer columns.

tokens.name: bp-desk
tokens.usage: From this width the review page in the back office shows the item and its evidence side by side.

heights.name: bp-short
heights.usage: Up to this height (a phone on its side, a page zoomed to 400%) nothing sticks: the header, the pinned home box, the home list heads and the consent bar scroll with the page.
